ResearchProjectDef.label: Artillery in a Single Round
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develops portable launchers and 40x46mm low-velocity ammunition. Chemical and less-lethal rounds also require their corresponding control technologies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Engineering Inside the Bullet
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develops enhanced-performance, armor-piercing and specialized precision cartridges beyond standard service ammunition.

ResearchProjectDef.label: A Hand Beyond the Trigger
ResearchProjectDef.description: Connects dedicated control terminals, powered mounts and sighting systems so an operator can control a weapon from cover.
